confirmedRequires: An independently executed reproduction artifact tied to this exact workspace digest and the reported trigger; model assertions or majority agreement are insufficient.
locationMatching: Normalize workspace-relative paths and match a hidden target path; source location alone is insufficient without the concrete trigger and independent evidence.
negativeSampleScope: Only the frozen target defect is labelled absent; other reproducible findings require separate review rather than automatic false-positive classification.
semanticAndIndependentRunBinding: Implemented/verified in RAT-05; current stage prepares labels and exact executable baseline oracles only.
